name: hidePlayer
description: Hides the specified player from your client render view.
parameters: username: String — Username of player to hide.

name: showPlayer
description: Unhides a previously hidden player in your client view.
parameters: username: String — Username of player to unhide.

name: sendFriendRequest
description: Sends a friend request to another player username.
parameters: username: String — Username of player to invite.

name: getFriends
description: Returns a list of all your accepted friends.
returns: List<String> — List of active friend usernames.

name: isPremium
description: Returns true if the player has Premium addon features active.
returns: Boolean — True if premium status active.
